paite: Huai lou in leng Israel heutute tungtang ah suunna la phuah ahi;
heading: Dahla

paite: Na nu bang ahia ahih? Humpinelkaipi ahi! Humpinelkaite lak ah akual a, humpinelkai lunlaite lak ah anoute avaklian hi.
Huan anoute lak ah khat avaktei a; humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
Namte'n leng atanchin aza ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-om; huan Aigupta gam ah sikkawi in amah api uh.
Huchi in angak a, alametna avuaksuak chih atheih in, anoute lak ah khat ala a, humpinelkai lun lai in abawl hi.
Humpinelkai lak ah apaisuk paitou a, humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi a; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
Ama'n a-inpi kisesate uh athei a, akhopite uh ahihgawp a, gam asegawp a, ahumham husa ziak in, huai a tengteng.
Huchi in bialte a kipan in ning chih a namte'n amah adou ua; atung ah alen uh azak ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-omta hi.
Sikkawite in bawm sung ah akoih ua; Babulon kumpipa kiang ah api ua; kulh muanhuaite sung ah apilut uh; huchi a Israel tang sangte tung a aw akizak nawnlouhna ding in.
Na nu na sisan a grepgui bang ahi, tuite kiang a suan; tui tampite ziak in gahpha leh hiangte in adim.
Huan vaihawmna pote lalchiang sikchiang khauh a nei in, nah bawkpha lak ah asandan uh hihsang in a-om hi, huchi in ahiang tampite uh toh sangpi amuh in a-om uhi.
Himahleh thangpaihna a bohkhiak in a-om a, lei ah paihkhiak in a-om a, suahlam huih in agah amutkeu a; akung khauhte kitan in akeu a; mei in amaute akang beita.
Huan tu in gamdai ah, gamkeu leh tui om lou ah phuh in a-om.
Huchi in ahiang a sikchiang a pan mei apaikhia, agah ahulbei a, huchi in amah ah vaihawm ding in lalchiang ding sikchiang khauh a-om kei hi. Hiai kahla ahi, kahla a dia sak ahi ding hi.
